defect: D-RM0-2 (mixed quote currencies aggregated fail-open; found 2026-10-06 by the RM0 closure review)

units.price: quote currency per one unit of base asset (per instrument)
units.notional: quote currency of the instrument (reference_notional = quantity x reference price)
units.fee: quote currency of the instrument (P2-X contract; never summed across quotes)
units.shares_weights_heat: unitless ratio, defined only over positions sharing one quote currency (and, for capital ratios, equal to the capital currency)

rule: A cross-position monetary or notional-weighted aggregate is VALID only if every position it aggregates has the same canonical quote currency. Otherwise it is UNAVAILABLE with reason mixed_quote_currencies_no_fx_conversion. Capital ratios additionally require the portfolio quote currency to equal the hypothetical capital currency, else UNAVAILABLE with reason capital_currency_mismatch_no_fx_conversion and exceeds_hypothetical_capital = null.
currency_identity: canonical quote currency from the instrument identity; no case folding and no stablecoin aliasing (USDT, FDUSD, USDC, TUSD, BUSD are distinct units); no epsilon: any non-zero foreign-quote position makes the set mixed
fx_conversion: NOT SUPPORTED in this version; a future PIT-safe conversion basis with provenance is an extension point and is never invented
unchanged: per-instrument and unitless values; partition by_quote_currency and by_symbol; counts; regime; drawdown
historical_evidence: sealed RM0 v1 evidence (code 9c7b750, logical hash 9ff677e8...788b) is not rewritten; all its non-flat snapshots are single-quote USDT
